cues: The pressure amplitude is rho v omega a, and the pressure wave is a quarter wavelength out of step with displacement.
Intensity goes as amplitude squared and frequency squared, and falls as one over r squared.
Intensity level is ten log I over I nought: double the intensity for three more decibels.
Loudness is a sensation, pitch is frequency, and quality is set by the overtones.
And the Doppler formula is f dash equals v plus v o, over v minus v s, times f, with approach counted positive.
text: Let us recap. The pressure amplitude is rho v omega a, and the pressure wave is a quarter wavelength out of step with displacement. Intensity goes as amplitude squared and frequency squared, and falls as one over r squared. Intensity level is ten log I over I nought: double the intensity for three more decibels. Loudness is a sensation, pitch is frequency, and quality is set by the overtones. And the Doppler formula is f dash equals v plus v o, over v minus v s, times f, with approach counted positive.
